business_problem: replace batch-oriented, fragmented marketing workflows with governed real-time AI that can personalize campaigns without moving sensitive customer data into external services.
solution_summary: Simon AI built its agentic marketing platform directly on Snowflake's AI Data Cloud so marketing, data, and AI can operate inside one governed environment. First-, second-, and third-party structured and unstructured data stay in Snowflake instead of moving through reverse ETL or external APIs. Snowflake Cortex AI applies row-level LLM logic across billions of events and millions of profiles, while Snowflake data sharing and Snowflake Marketplace enrich customer records with weather, location, and market signals. Engineers build agents in SQL or Python, deploy them with Snowpark Container Services, and use Snowpark plus Dynamic Tables to keep real-time pipelines current. The resulting blueprints assemble reusable agents for intent detection, sentiment analysis, predictive scoring, and campaign activation so Simon customers can launch cross-channel campaigns faster and target audiences with more precision.
